# Implement watermark and CDC logic inside notebooks (`playbook-development-22`)

The script generates the starter code for implementing incremental data load patterns based on the provided system context. For example:
Source ADLS Path - abfss://salesdata@contosodata.dfs.core.windows.net/2026/source/Invoice/ date wise column
Target ADLS Path - abfss://salesdata@contosodata.dfs.core.windows.net/2026/taget/Invoice/ date wise column
Key column(s) for CDC (primary key or unique identifier) - Date column
Timestamp column for watermark logic: Date column
Mode of CDC (e.g., append-only, upsert): Append
Watermark table location - abfss://salesdata@contosodata.dfs.core.windows.net/2026/watermarks/

Based on this system context, the generated script provides the initial implementation for the incremental load pattern, processes the data from the source to the target, and updates the watermark table to track the last processed timestamp for subsequent runs.
